mechanism: Embed one impossible following behavior inside a familiar transport routine, make a visible device produce a clear causal threshold before the behavior begins, then sustain a single view long enough to prove a stable matched-speed convoy. Setup, activation, acceleration, lift and proof must remain continuous; operator, payload, lead transport, lift mechanism, route, camera axis and tone are variable.

invariants.rule: Establish the secondary payload grounded in an ordinary transport routine.
invariants.ablation_failure: Starting airborne makes the behavior arbitrary.

invariants.rule: Show one mechanical device fitted and activated before lift.
invariants.ablation_failure: Hidden or late cause turns flight into unexplained magic.

invariants.rule: Let device output increase until a visible threshold triggers smooth lift.
invariants.ablation_failure: Instant teleporting or jumping breaks causal continuity.

invariants.rule: Match the payload's forward speed to the lead transport in one sustained view.
invariants.purpose: Proves stable convoy behavior under motion.
invariants.ablation_failure: A short cutaway cannot verify relative position.

invariants.rule: Keep the operator calm and the moving payload mechanically stable after the impossible event.
invariants.purpose: Preserves the deadpan whimsical tone without depending on a living companion.
invariants.ablation_failure: Panic, wobble or loss of payload control reframes the proof as danger or failure.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original subject whose identity and silhouette remain stable.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific location.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One readable variable that changes monotonically or in countable stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: One restrained performance rule that makes the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: A coherent information order that does not copy the source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: One clean physical or graphic consequence that closes the causal chain.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: A new hierarchy of diegetic cues supporting each state change.

anti_copy_exclusions: young woman in cream sweats riding a pale scooter
silver tabby cat wearing a yellow propeller helmet
source side tracking composition and cat body pose

instantiations.concept: An archive porter clips four magnetic shoes to a sealed specimen crate on the floor; sequential induction-rail cells reach a visible threshold, the crate rises and follows a catalog cart at a fixed trailing distance through an S-shaped aisle in one overhead-oblique take. The porter remains calm and the sealed crate stays rigid without wobble throughout the convoy proof.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Worker-and-cargo relation, rail-powered magnetic lift, trailing convoy geometry and overhead proof.

instantiations.concept: A greenhouse technician attaches a thermal ring to a seed vault; ceiling vents reach a marked temperature threshold and the vault floats behind a hand trolley while a fixed gantry camera proves constant separation. The technician remains calm and the seed vault stays rigid without sway or loss of control.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Cargo levitation with thermal cause and rear-following rather than side-by-side animal flight.

instantiations.concept: A stage rigger powers an air-bearing base under a silent prop chest; pressure segments illuminate, the chest rises and follows a scenery dolly through a curved backstage path from a frontal retreating camera. The rigger remains calm and the chest stays rigid through the complete proof.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Visible pressure threshold, nonliving cargo and frontal convoy proof.

failure_modes.failure: The payload floats before the mechanism activates.
failure_modes.repair: Hold a grounded baseline and show output increasing before lift.

failure_modes.failure: Cuts hide the lift or matched-speed proof.
failure_modes.repair: Use one continuous view across activation, lift and travel.

failure_modes.failure: The operator panics or the payload becomes visibly unstable.
failure_modes.repair: Keep operator behavior calm and preserve rigid, mechanically supported payload motion.
